Repeated peals of thunder have been heard over a certain area of Greengrass Isle! Follow-up research in the area revealed bits of Raikou Mane that Raikou left behind. According to Professor Neroli, he’ll be able to conduct research into Raikou’s sleep habits if you collect lots of Raikou Mane samples during your sleep research. You can trade these Raikou Mane samples via the Event Exchange for new items—Raikou Incense and Raikou Biscuits—to help you see Raikou’s sleep styles! Event Outline The Raikou Research event lasts from 4:00 a.m. on Monday, March 25 until 3:59 a.m. on Monday, April 8 on Greengrass Isle ! The Legendary Pokémon Raikou will appear during sleep research for the first time , and this two-week event is a special opportunity to concentrate on researching it ! During this event, you can collect samples of Raikou Mane to exchange via the Event Exchange for items, such as Raikou Incense and Raikou Biscuits . You can use Raikou Incense to research Raikou’s various sleep styles! Note: Even without Raikou Incense, Raikou may appear during sleep research—but extremely rarely. For researchers who would like to befriend Raikou , we recommend using Raikou Biscuits , which are specialized for use with Raikou only. Also, Electric-type helper Pokémon will be particularly helpful during this event! Note: Electric-type helper Pokémon include Pikachu, Raichu, Jolteon, Raikou, Pichu, Mareep, Flaaffy, Ampharos, and Dedenne. In addition, you’ll be able to encounter Pokémon of different sleep types regardless of your own . Electric-type Pokémon in particular will have a greater appearance rate . During this event, you’ll be able to take on two sets of limited-time missions, Week 1 Missions and Week 2 Missions, to earn samples of Raikou Mane as rewards! Week 1 Mission period: Monday, March 25 at 4:00 a.m. to Monday, April 8 at 3:59 a.m. Week 2 Mission period: Monday, April 1 at 4:00 a.m. to Monday, April 8 at 3:59 a.m. Please see below for more details about this event. Event Exchange Exchange Period: Monday, March 25, at 4:00 a.m. to Thursday, April 11, at 3:59 a.m. This is a shop where you can exchange samples of Raikou Mane for the following items. • Raikou Incense • Raikou Biscuit • Main Skill Seed • Thunder Stone And more! • Also, a few Raikou Incense and Raikou Biscuits will be added at a slightly lower exchange rate in the second week of the event. Keep an eye out for these during the last stretch of the event! What is Raikou Incense? • An incense adored by Raikou. • If you set this on the stump labeled “Incense” next to your tent on the home screen before you begin sleep tracking, you will for sure be able to meet Raikou during your next sleep research. • You can have up to one in your bag’s items pocket at a time. Note: Incense that you have set still counts as being inside your bag’s items pocket until it’s consumed during sleep research. • It can be used starting from the time Raikou begins appearing: Monday, March 25, at 3:00 p.m. • It can also be used after the event has ended. What are Raikou Biscuits? • These can be used during sleep research within the event period and only with Raikou . • One Raikou Biscuit increases Raikou’s friendship points by 6 . • After the Event Exchange closes, any Raikou Biscuits that you have will be automatically converted into Great Biscuits.
